email.body:
Port report, Samarinda, 20 Jan 2025.

Crane No. 2 broke down at 0115 UTC: luffing wire rope parted. Loading at hold 2 stopped until the wire was renewed; crane back in service 0605 UTC. Other cranes working normally.

Master MV BRYONY HEAD

result.result: The Master reports that crane No. 2 broke down from 0115 UTC to 0605 UTC on 20 Jan 2025, during which loading at hold 2 stopped. According to the CP off-hire clause and its crane rider, since the breakdown prevented the full working of the vessel, the ship is off hire pro rata for the time lost. For this period of 4.83 hours with one of four cranes out of use (share 0.25), the simulated hire statement shows a hire deduction of 604.17 USD. The operator should decide whether to put the ship off hire pro rata and notify the owner. If agreed, I will (a) propose a voyage management system entry for the off-hire period with one crane out of use, and (b) draft an e-mail to the owner's vessel technical management giving the period, the crane, and the reason. I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
